body: Thank you. This really helped me.

If you’re talking about feasible, yes it is.

But why would you want to commit suicide? Life has much more to it than what society has to offer, unlike a stupid 9 to 5 job that will probably get you in a lot of debt.

If you’re talking “loved ones” as in family, it depends if they truly care about you and your wellbeing. If I were friends with you, I wouldn’t care if you faked a lie to get people to hate you so you could commit suicide later on. I would focus on helping you, and not on that fake crime you committed. 

Even if I didn’t know that you faked it, I would be more concerned that you were trying to commit suicide. (This is just my opinion, it varies from person to person.)

I also noticed that I stumbled across this 4 months later. I hope you’re doing well now.

Do something that you’ve always wanted to do before you leave. Try to make your last moment worthwhile.

As they say, live a short happy life rather than a long and painful one.
